approvedFrom: gscIndexedGeneratedPages.ts build_required fix, reviewed via GSC Coverage Drilldown audit
notes: Baseline reduced 2026-09-23 after fixing a real generator bug, not a regression: buildPage() in gscIndexedGeneratedPages.ts was building every row with current_v2_status==="missing_not_built" regardless of the row's own build_required field. 218 rows across the whole dataset had build_required:false (mostly page_type:"location-service-matrix", the /locations/{area}/{service}-kochi/ pattern) with explicit reasons like "do not recreate old pSEO risk" -- a prior comment in the same function incorrectly claimed these were "intentionally still built". Cross-checked against a live GSC 404/crawled-not-indexed export: 131 of these were live pages Google had actively crawled and declined to index. Fixed by adding build_required===false to the skip condition. All 23 real location hub pages (build_required:true, current_v2_status:built_200, built via a separate static-file mechanism) are unaffected and confirmed still present. This is the second, corrected baseline after the PR #12 restoration this note previously referenced -- that restoration brought back pages this fix now removes for a documented, evidenced reason, not a side effect.
